result.summary: Several layout overflow issues clip restaurant names, category chips, and promo cards, plus a few visual inconsistencies in badges and the bottom tab bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off on the right, clipping the restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol') and part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough padding or peek so names and images are fully visible, or wrap/truncate names with ellipsis after a complete word.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right (partial 'Healthy' and a cut-off next chip), so users cannot see the full set of filters.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding and a clear scroll affordance so the last visible chip is fully on-screen.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant promo card is cut off by the tab bar, hiding most of the card content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Delivery-time badges sit inconsistently on cards (centered on the first card, overlapping the burger image on the second).
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent badge position and contrast treatment on every card.

issues.description: The Orders tab icon appears faint or incomplete compared with the other tab icons.
issues.suggestion: Use the same stroke weight and color as the other inactive tab icons.
